name: NUB Userbot
description: A powerful, highly modular, and clean Pyrogram based Telegram Userbot.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from my.telegram.org

BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional: A Bot Token from @BotFather (used for inline bot features)

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional: AI gateway API key (needed for AI features: .ask and Word Grid vision)

AI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of your Anthropic-compatible AI gateway (e.g. https://api.example.com). Required alongside AI_API_KEY for the AI features.

AGENT_VISION_MODEL.description: Optional: vision-capable model used for Word Grid image extraction

AGENT_ALLOW_SHELL.description: Optional: let the AI agent run shell commands. Leave false unless you trust every message you .ask about — replied-to text is included in the prompt, so enabling this turns other people's messages into a path to command execution.

YTUBE_API_KEY.description: Optional: API Key for YTUBE to download YouTube videos

YTUBE_BASE_URL.description: Optional: Base URL for YTUBE API (defaults to https://api.nubcoders.com)

MONGO_URI.description: Optional: MongoDB connection URI for persistent storage (falls back to in-memory storage if unset)
